content_fields.title: Verify that the origin and integrity of remote code and updates are checked (client side)
content_fields.description: Check the integrity of content retrieved from a remote origin before it is accepted.
content_fields.finding: Content retrieved from a remote origin is accepted without any integrity verification before it is persisted and later served.

def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image

# app/apis/menu/utils.py
EXPECTED_DIGESTS = load_content_manifest()      # signed manifest, refreshed out of band


def _fetch_verified(url: str) -> bytes:
    content = _fetch_image(url)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    if digest != EXPECTED_DIGESTS.get(url):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Content integrity check failed")
    return content
criteria: Retrieved content is compared against a digest from a trusted, signed manifest.
A mismatch aborts the operation and is logged.
